description: API-gap FSAE 2027 tasks for experiment 6 (scenarios, chains, physical paths, transitions). Scored as fsae-2027-depth.json.
requires: The FSAE-2027-Electric-Arcadia model, the same pristine copy as fsae-2027.json.

tasks.prompt: Illustrate the logical shutdown capability 'FSAE2027:shutdown Logical capability realization' with a functional scenario 'FSAE2027:BMS trip opens the shutdown path': the BMS issues its trip ('FSAE2027:SD LA Independent BMS shutdown trip'), the accepted trip requests the shutdown path to open ('FSAE2027:SD LA Any series path open request'), and the trip cause is latched ('FSAE2027:SD LA BMS IMD BSPD protective-trip cause'), in that order.

exchanges.name: FSAE2027:SD LA Independent BMS shutdown trip
FSAE2027:SD LA Any series path open request
FSAE2027:SD LA BMS IMD BSPD protective-trip cause

tasks.prompt: In the logical architecture, model one functional chain 'FSAE2027:Any trip opens the shutdown path' that gathers every trip entering 'FSAE2027:SD Accept independent shutdown trips' and continues to 'FSAE2027:SD Open high-side shutdown current path'.

method.name: FSAE2027:Any trip opens the shutdown path

exchanges.name: FSAE2027:SD LA Independent IMD shutdown trip
FSAE2027:SD LA Direct manual switch opening
FSAE2027:SD LA Independent BMS shutdown trip
FSAE2027:SD LA Any series path open request

tasks.prompt: The battery safety status ('FSAE2027:PA Battery safety status transport') runs in a harness from 'FSAE2027:energy-storage Equipment' through 'FSAE2027:low-voltage Equipment' to 'FSAE2027:shutdown Equipment'. Model that physical route in the physical architecture and make the component exchange travel on it.

Add a logical component 'FSAE2027:Charge port interlock monitor' inside 'FSAE2027:charging Logical subsystem', with a logical function 'FSAE2027:Monitor charge port interlock' allocated to it. Then carry both into the physical architecture the way Capella does, so that each keeps its traceability to the logical one.
